summary: 8-phase plan (7.5h, 4 waves) covering both parts. Part 1 (phases 1,2,4,5,6): backup the 154-chunk set, derive Wijesekera's own numbered section headings via pdftotext -layout, rebuild a reflow tool, chunk in scratch, promote, validate Definition 1.1.4 and the Section 2 diamond material. Part 2 (phases 3,7,8): non-blocking mean-chunk-size guard in literature-ingest.sh after line 268, two-signal OCR heading hardening in literature-convert.sh, plus a before/after corpus regression audit. Plan explicitly corrects the task's Tesseract/OCRmyPDF-only premise.
decisions_made: OCR detection is two independent signals: a broadened producer family (Tesseract, OCRmyPDF, Acrobat/Adobe Capture, ABBYY, ScanSoft, FineReader) AND structural cues that fire regardless of producer metadata -- cues are NOT producer-gated

Task 518's reflow tooling was verified NOT preserved (absent from .claude/scripts and from the archived task dir); phase 4 rebuilds it as a durable script, which is why effort exceeds the original 3-5h estimate
Part 2 hardening does not make Part 1 redundant: suppressing false headings leaves Wijesekera with few/no headings, so bespoke heading insertion is still required for retrieval quality
literature-chunk.sh and Cslib/ are explicitly out of scope; the chunk-size guard warns and continues rather than hard-failing like run_quality_gate's exit-3
Parts are independently revertible: if the reflow cannot reach a healthy profile, phase 5 is blocked and Part 2 ships alone
